name: relay_route_intent
why: As a low-latency front door, I need a safe, explicit way to route recognized user intents to downstream agents (mac-planner/mac-vision) and receive status, without inventing my own protocol.

utterance.description: The raw or normalized user utterance.

context.description: Optional session context such as locale, time, and any already-known constraints.

target.description: Preferred target agent id, e.g. 'mac-planner' or 'mac-vision'.

status: Granted as a schema and not resolvable to anything real (unresolved). Calling it returns that verdict and the nearest real capabilities, not an action.
note: If this tool takes an enum, each value resolves separately — one branch can be live while another is not.
